FEAT-4-STORY-68.title: Validate NPI Input and Handle Lookup Errors
FEAT-4-STORY-68.description: Implement strict validation for NPI inputs (length, numeric format) and robust error handling for CMS API failures, timeouts, and empty responses with standardized error objects.

FEAT-4-STORY-69.title: Validate and Sanitize External Provider Links
FEAT-4-STORY-69.description: Integrate url_guardian to validate, sanitize, and defang generated external links (state boards, research sites) before returning them to the chat layer.

FEAT-4-STORY-70.title: Add Lightweight Caching for NPI Lookup Results
FEAT-4-STORY-70.description: Implement in-memory or short TTL caching for NPI lookup responses to reduce repeated CMS API calls and improve response latency.
FEAT-4-STORY-70.evidence: ASSUMPTION: provider_detail_service performs live API calls without caching; GAP: confirm caching strategy or introduce lightweight cache layer consistent with existing services.
